coverage.landlord_size_condition: Any rental property owner owning, directly or indirectly, one or more rental residential dwelling units. A person holding a controlling interest in an owning entity counts as a single rental property owner with that entity.
coverage.summary: Covers residential dwelling units in New Jersey: any house, apartment, accessory unit or other unit intended to be used as a primary residence. Inpatient medical care, licensed long-term care and detention or correctional facilities are excluded.

evidence.quoted_span:
means a person that owns, directly or indirectly, one or more

“Residential dwelling unit” means any house, apartment,
accessory unit, or other unit intended to be used as a primary residence in the
State.

“Residential dwelling unit” shall not include inpatient medical care,

result.notes: I removed other_conditions (set to null). The exclusions it listed describe conduct and tools, not buildings, units or owners: research or testing uses, free public rent estimates, brokerage databases, government affordability controls, non-AI spreadsheets and query-only databases. Those belong under exemptions, not coverage. I reworded the summary to follow the statutory definition ("intended to be used as a primary residence"). I expanded landlord_size_condition to quote the controlling-interest rule precisely. All other fields were kept and are supported by D069.
